title: Isezerano ryavuzwe hejuru y'inkwi
intro: Uhagaze iruhande y’umuriro wo mu bugaragwa uko inkwi zawo zikwiragizwa witonze. Abashitsi barashika kugira ngo bahurire mu gacerere, ubutumwa bumwe gusa bugafungura inkuru y’isezerano, y’ugutangara, n’akazoza katararanguka.
clues: Twarajabutse urugendo kugira ngo tugere ku musuku w’intahemuka wo mu bugaragwa.
Twarasavye ko boshira inkwi kugira ngo bategure umuriro.
Twaravuganye n’umwe yari yahamagaye urubeya kugira ngo hakonje kandi habeho umutekano.
Twarazaniye inkuru y’umwana aherutse kuvuka umuntu yari yararengeje imyaka yo kuvyara abana.
Twarazaniye Ibrahimu inkuru nziza y’umuhungu, iyo nkuru itangaje iratuma Ibrahimu atwenga.
